title.zh: 在帕赛市设立国立科学中学，名称为帕赛市国立科学中学，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Establishing a National Science High School in the City of Pasay to Be Known as Pasay City National Science High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National Science High School in the City of Pasay to Be Known as Pasay City National Science High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông khoa học quốc gia tại Thành phố Pasay được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông khoa học quốc gia Pasay City
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมวิทยาศาสตร์แห่งชาติในเมือง Pasay ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมวิทยาศาสตร์แห่งชาติ Pasay City
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Sains Nasional di Kota Pasay dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Sains Nasional Pasay City
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Sains Kebangsaan di Bandaraya Pasay dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Sains Kebangsaan Pasay City

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2016/ra_10829_2016.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Establishment of a National Science High School. – There is hereby established, under the supervision of the Department of Education, a national science high school in the City of Pasay to be known as Pasay City National Science High School.

Appropriations. – The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Pasay City National Science High School, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. – The Secretary of Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. – This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
